title: Chapter 1345
text:
He looked back at the frequency of his leave requests. From the beginning of the year until now, he had accumulated exactly seven days of rest, which was an average of one day of rest per month. He felt that it was still passable. He was a normal person with no mutation in his liver function.

Godly Mechanic stayed up a little too late, so he applied for a day of leave.
